description:
We are looking for a motivated Sales Executive to join our growing logistics team. If you have experience in freight forwarding and enjoy building customer relationships, we'd love to hear from you!
What You'll Do
* Proactively seek out and approach potential customers in need of logistics and delivery services (sea, air, and road), especially in the USA market.
* Establish and expand a customer network, building lasting relationships with potential customers.
* Nurture and maintain good relationships with existing customers.
* Coordinate with the operations and customer service departments to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Prepare quotations and track customer requests.
* Negotiate freight rates with customers and work with overseas agents.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and KPIs.
* Update sales and customer information in the management system.
* Conduct market and competitor research to support development strategy.
requirements_text:
What We're Looking For
* Graduated from college/university with a major in Economics, International Business, Logistics, or related fields.
* At least one year of experience in the freight forwarding/logistics business (preferably sea or air freight).
* Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the USA market.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
* Confident, customer-oriented, and able to handle sales pressure.
* Good English skills (listening, speaking, reading, and writing); knowledge of other foreign languages is an advantage.
* Able to work independently or in a team.
* Willing to meet with clients when necessary.
Kiến thức ngành
Logistic / Vận tải
Kỹ năng cần có
English, Communication, Persuasion, Negotiation
Kỹ năng nên có
Air freight, Sea Freight, USA market
